_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/ledger/test_modified_creatures_died.py. t_md_scribe is Intermediate Chirography's level-3 trigger alone, on an enchantment with nothing else printed, gaining 1 life instead of making an Inkling so the test reads a life total. The creatures, Auras and Equipment are tests/data/enchanted_by.cards.json's and tests/data/attached_to_host.cards.json's.

cards.name: Test Modified Scribe
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of each end step, if a modified creature died under your control this turn, you gain 1 life.
